title: BARBELL BENCH PRESS
instructions: Lie on the bench with eyes under the bar and feet planted.
Unrack with locked elbows and lower the bar to mid-chest.
Press up in a slight arc until elbows lock without bouncing.
Keep shoulder blades pinched and a natural arch in the back.

title: PULL-UP
instructions: Grasp the pull-up bar with an overhand grip wider than shoulder-width.
Pull your body up until your chin clears the bar.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower yourself with control.

title: BACK SQUAT
instructions: Rest the barbell across your upper back with a firm grip.
Break at the hips and knees to lower into a deep squat.
Drive through your heels to return to a standing position.

title: OVERHEAD PRESS
instructions: Hold the barbell at shoulder height with palms facing forward.
Press the bar overhead until arms are fully extended.
Lower the bar back to collarbone level with control.

title: DUMBBELL BICEP CURL
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at arm's length.
Curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.

title: HOLLOW-BODY PLANK
instructions: Place forearms on the floor with elbows aligned under shoulders.
Engage core and keep legs straight, forming a flat line from head to heels.
Hold the position firmly without letting hips sag.

title: CONVENTIONAL DEADLIFT
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart and mid-foot under the bar.
Grip the bar, engage lats, and keep back flat.
Drive through heels to lift the bar until standing erect.

title: PUSH-UP
instructions: Place hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Lower your chest until it nearly touches the floor.
Push back up to full extension maintaining a rigid body line.

title: WALKING LUNGE
instructions: Step forward with one leg and lower hips until both knees bend at 90 degrees.
Push off back foot to step forward into the next lunge.
Keep torso upright throughout the movement.

title: RUSSIAN TWIST
instructions: Sit on the floor, lean back slightly, and lift feet off the ground.
Twist your torso from side to side touching the weight to the floor.
Keep core engaged continuously.
